{{- /* BEGIN Ventz Changes: replace PaperMod's generic recursive printer with a
     spec-shaped llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org/): H1, a `>` blockquote summary, a
     short orientation paragraph, then H2-ONLY sections. The upstream template
     recursed into subsections and emitted headings down to `#####` for the legacy
     documentation tree, which (a) is off-spec and (b) gave 40+ archival stubs the
     same weight as real writing. Here that tree is flattened into the spec's
     `## Optional` section, which consumers are explicitly allowed to skip when
     working in a short context. Posts carry a date + one-line description as the
     spec's "optional link details" so a model can choose without fetching each URL.
     Rendered as text/plain by the `llms` outputFormat in hugo.yaml (home page only)
     -> /llms.txt. Regenerated every build; nothing here is hand-maintained. */ -}}
{{- /* Ventz Changes: one-line detail for a post — the explicit front-matter
     description when set, else Hugo's auto summary, collapsed to a single line so
     it cannot break the markdown list. */ -}}
{{- define "llms_detail" -}}
{{- $d := cond (ne .Description "") .Description (.Summary | plainify) -}}
{{- /* Ventz Changes: truncate FIRST, unescape SECOND. Hugo's `truncate` HTML-escapes
     plain-string input (a straight quote comes back as `&#34;`), so folding entities
     before it would be undone. Unescaping after also resolves the `&ldquo;`-style
     entities the markdown typographer emits, plus truncate's own `…` suffix. */ -}}
{{- $d = $d | truncate 160 | htmlUnescape -}}
{{- /* Ventz Changes: fold typographic punctuation back to the site's ASCII-only
     convention rather than leaking curly quotes into a machine-readable index. */ -}}
{{- $d = $d | replaceRE "[“”]" `"` | replaceRE "[‘’]" "'" -}}
{{- $d = $d | replaceRE "[—–]" "-" | replaceRE "…" "..." -}}
{{- $d = $d | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace -}}
{{- with $d }}{{ printf " - %s" . }}{{ end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- /* Ventz Changes: "Security / Firewalls"-style trail for a legacy doc page. The
     two levels every one of them shares (Legacy, Documentation) are dropped as noise. */ -}}
{{- define "llms_trail" -}}
{{- $crumbs := slice -}}
{{- range .Ancestors.Reverse -}}
{{- if and (ne .Kind "home") (ne .Title "Legacy") (ne .Title "Documentation") -}}
{{- $crumbs = $crumbs | append .Title -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- with $crumbs -}}
: {{ delimit . " / " }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- /* Ventz Changes: page sets. `.Section` is the FIRST path element, so the nested
     legacy tree and the flat posts tree both resolve from one `where` each. */ -}}
{{- $skip := "archives search" -}}
{{- $posts := where site.RegularPages "Section" "posts" -}}
{{- $legacy := where site.RegularPages "Section" "legacy" -}}
{{- $pages := where site.RegularPages "Section" "" -}}
# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description }} - the personal blog of {{ site.Params.author }} Petkov, covering systems administration, security, networking, self-hosting, and the occasional gadget.

Every URL below serves the complete article: no paywall, no login, no client-side
rendering. Two machine-readable indexes cover the same content -
{{ site.Home.Permalink }}index.xml (RSS, full article bodies) and
{{ site.Home.Permalink }}index.json (title, tags, summary and full text of every page).

## Posts
{{ range $posts }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ template "llms_detail" . }}
{{- end }}

## Pages
{{ range $pages }}
{{- if and (not .Params.searchHidden) (not (in (split $skip " ") .Layout)) }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }})
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

## Optional

Archived documentation migrated from the old WordPress wiki, kept online so the
original URLs keep resolving. Many entries are terse notes or empty category
placeholders - skip this section entirely when working with a limited context.
{{ range $legacy }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}){{ template "llms_trail" . }}
{{- end }}
{{- /* END Ventz Changes */}}
